_help: Changes to the tables the game plays by. The Game data page in Clan Mod Studio writes this file for you: its Quick changes, a search for any number, and every table. By hand: a table's name (under Gameplay/DataTables/NonAsset), then its rows by their first column; "*" is every row. A value is a number, text, true/false, or "x1.5" to multiply the game's number. Inside one file "*" goes first and a named row wins over it. docs/formats.md has the rest.
